question:

**Given: **

Rita is the mother of Deepa.

Deepa is the sister of Aman.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f7003894f2c8e4b2b98040f84970827d205875ab5d984b6cf4e08825523d4de.png]
